content:
nina: Heads-up - NovaMed wants a Private POC. Must use customer's HSM/KMS, no key export, and they need CloudTrail logs sent to their S3. 4-week window. Can we run this?

omar: Yes. Two tracks: 1) customer CloudHSM + KMS Custom Key Store (they keep material), 2) BYOK import with RSA-OAEP wrapped material. Track 1 preferred for their compliance.

lucy: What we need from them: HSM cluster ARN or public wrapping key, role ARN(s) for cross-account assume, S3 bucket ARN for logs, and whether they want us to generate CSR or they will provide certs.

infra-bot: infra-note: estimated infra work 3 business days after we receive ARNs and wrapping key. Will prepare terraform module for role/trust policy.

nina: Also procurement asked for a price ballpark for 1x ded pool (3 GPUs equiv) for 4 weeks. I'll give a placeholder and mark as provisional.

omar: Security checklist: HSM attestation doc preferred, no export at any point, automated cert rotation (recommended 30d), and audit forwarding. Offer Redwood-managed HSM-backed CMK as temporary fallback so testing can start.

lucy: I'll draft the minimal IAM trust snippet and a short runbook for BYOK vs CloudHSM flows. Posting examples here when ready.

nina: Action items: (1) ask NovaMed for HSM info + role ARNs + S3 details, (2) Lucy to prepare terraform snippet, (3) Omar to draft fallback options. Will update thread with reply. :thumbsup:
